build_image_transform_pipeline: build a training or evaluation image transform pipeline using image_transform with specified image size and normalization
create_resize_max_size_module: create a ResizeMaxSize module that resizes images to fit within a max size while preserving aspect ratio
test_resize_max_size_forward: test the ResizeMaxSize forward pass on a PIL image or torch tensor to verify resizing and padding
get_openai_mean_std: get the OpenAI dataset mean and standard deviation values for image normalization via get_mean_std
review_image_transform_options: review the image_transform function to compare training vs evaluation mode and resize_longest_max behavior
